english.title: Use on a road a motor vehicle with a mascot / emblem / ornamental object in a position likely to cause injury
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on which was carried

(A)_[a mascot,]_
(B)_[an emblem,]_
(C)_[an ornamental object,]_

in such a position that it was likely to strike a person with whom the vehicle might collide
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 53(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 53(1) only applies to vehicles first used on or after 1.10.37.
(ii) Mascots not liable to cause injury to such a person as mentioned above by virtue of projections are excepted.
(iii) Instead of complying with regulation 53(1), the vehicle may comply with Community Directive 74/483 or 79/488 or EEC Regulation 26.01.
(iv) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(v) See also offence wordings: H2572 and H2573.
(vi) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied

6 months
